# app/controllers/api/v1/products_controller.rb
class Api::V1::ProductsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  # GET /api/v1/products?category=electronics&sort=price
  def index
    category = params[:category]
    sort_col = params[:sort] || 'name'
    sort_dir = params[:direction] || 'ASC'
    min_price = params[:min_price]
    max_price = params[:max_price]
    
    # Build query with filters
    conditions = []
    conditions << "category = '#{category}'" if category.present?
    conditions << "price >= #{min_price}" if min_price.present?
    conditions << "price <= #{max_price}" if max_price.present?
    
    where_clause = conditions.any? ? "WHERE #{conditions.join(' AND ')}" : ''
    
    # Validate sort direction
    sort_dir = 'ASC' unless %w[ASC DESC].include?(sort_dir.upcase)
    
    # Note: sort_col is validated against allowed columns
    allowed_sorts = %w[name price created_at rating stock_count]
    sort_col = 'name' unless allowed_sorts.include?(sort_col)
    
    query = "SELECT id, name, category, price, rating, stock_count, description FROM products #{where_clause} ORDER BY #{sort_col} #{sort_dir} LIMIT 100"
    
    results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute(query)
    
    render json: {
      products: results.to_a,
      meta: {
        total: results.count,
        filters_applied: conditions.length
      }
    }
  end

  # GET /api/v1/products/:id
  def show
    product = Product.find(params[:id])
    render json: product
  end

  # GET /api/v1/products/search?q=laptop
  def search
    search_term = params[:q]
    return render json: { error: 'Missing search term' }, status: 400 if search_term.blank?
    
    # Use ILIKE for case-insensitive search
    query = "SELECT id, name, category, price, rating FROM products WHERE name ILIKE '%#{search_term}%' OR description ILIKE '%#{search_term}%' ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 50"
    
    results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute(query)
    render json: { results: results.to_a }
  end

  private

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless ApiKey.exists?(key: api_key, active: true)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: 401
    end
  end
end
